scope: Receiver-owned evidence-only lifecycle, canonical framing and durable write-before-ack interlock. No admission API, no prepared receipt, no VM implementation.
binding_format: Each binding is a SHA-256 of a separately specified identity document; source/tree fields are not literal Git object IDs. Their document schemas and authenticated origins remain unqualified. Process/channel identity values are compared, not established by this component.
implemented: Receiver-generated 256-bit launch and challenge; reservation flushed before exposure
Strict bounded canonical ASCII JSON, duplicate/unknown field and sequence/chain checks
Snapshot prospective policy independently supplied before any receiving event
Ordinary attempt persisted before membership decision; unknown definitions and every hidden family fail closed
Serial attempt-before-result and cutoff interlock; duplicate/refill/rollback/replay rejection
Concurrent consume accepts at most once; evidence consumption grants no execution authority
Full-write handling, file/directory fsync, permanent in-process failure on uncertainty
Directory-fd path traversal rejects symlinks; exclusive new transcript directory; no restart continuation
trust_assumptions: Trusted receiver Python process and all its callers; private attributes are not a security boundary
Authenticated future supervisor supplies bindings/events; knowing challenge or hashes is not authentication
Receiver-owned immutable parent namespace, OS, filesystem, storage and input-policy origin
No malicious privileged writer or storage rollback; a local hash chain is not rollback resistance
limits: No exact VM definition provenance, entry-path coverage, hidden-generator input provenance or actual attempted-load enforcement
No post-exec identity derivation or authenticated channel/signature
No externally anchored durable ledger, rollback-resistant restart reconciliation or power-loss storage qualification
No VM/toolchain build, immutable deployment or platform acceptance
No full supervisor/receiver qualification, prepared-worker acceptance, sealed launch or R1 permit
Rejecting all hidden families does not narrow or redefine the adopted LambdaForm exception; supporting provenance is absent
CLOSED and CONSUMED are evidence states only; they do not mean PREPARED or ADMITTED
qualification: 37 unittest methods, with additional identity/provenance subcases; deterministic synthetic non-corpus inputs except cryptographic freshness values. No experimental execution. Local attempt 1 passed; CI evidence is recorded separately.
preservation: V2 remains untouched and deliberately fail-closed. Supplemental capture membership is not consulted. Neither the original rule nor the mechanism proposal is modified.
review_requested: Independent Reviewer B source/receiver-evidence review only. No self-adoption or runtime/admission conclusion. Integration remains separately reviewed.
